title: Healthier bees: AlphaFold predicts vitellogenin's structure
summary: With the Norwegian University of Life Sciences, predicted structures of honeybee vitellogenin were confirmed by electron microscopy in July 2025; AlphaFold 3 helped study its interactions with other molecules. Early evidence suggests breeding times for resilient bees could fall from months to weeks, a still preliminary claim.
organization: Google DeepMind and Norwegian University of Life Sciences

evidence.tested: AlphaFold-predicted vitellogenin structures were confirmed by electron microscopy in July 2025, per the post; the linked paper reports a cryo-EM structure of native honey bee vitellogenin, and the breeding-time claim comes from early trials.
evidence.unknown: The breeding-time benefit (months to weeks) is preliminary and not cited to a publication, and implications for other egg-laying species are possibilities, not established findings.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold 3 predicted the vitellogenin structures and helped study how it binds other molecules inside the bee.
